technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Use Spring Shell to invoke REST APIs for StreamController validation.
U2: Adapt redis counter from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream using existing Redis binder.
U3: Set up CI using GitHub Actions with Maven build and commit hooks.
U4: Implement a custom Boot loader that resolves module dependencies from a repository (Maven coordinates) and adds them to the classpath.
U5: Refactor ModuleLauncher to be a Spring Boot application, leveraging Spring Boot's property management and auto-configuration.
U6: Investigate using PHD (Pivotal Hadoop Distribution) as a provider for HDFS module, likely using Spring for Apache Hadoop integration.
U7: Add REST endpoints to StreamController for stream commands (create, deploy, destroy, etc.) using Spring Web MVC.
U8: Set up CI for spring-cloud-stream-modules repository using GitHub Actions.
assumptions: All user stories are part of a single software increment for Spring Cloud projects.
Development environment is already set up with Java 17+, Maven/Gradle, and necessary tools.
The developer is familiar with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud projects.
Existing codebases for spring-cloud-data and spring-cloud-stream-modules are available and compilable.
No external dependencies need to be negotiated; all required libraries are available in public Maven repositories.
Effort estimates include design, implementation, unit testing, and basic documentation for each user story.
Integration testing and deployment are not part of this estimate unless explicitly required by the user story.
For U6, the effort is limited to investigation and prototyping; full implementation is deferred.

activities.activity_name: U1: Implement REST API shell invocation
activities.activity_description: Develop a shell command (using Spring Shell) that allows invoking REST APIs on StreamController for validation. Includes setting up shell project, implementing commands, and testing.

activities.activity_name: U2: Adapt redis counter from XD to s-c-s
activities.activity_description: Port the redis counter module from Spring XD to a Spring Cloud Stream module. Implement the counter logic using Redis binder, ensure compatibility, and write unit tests.

activities.activity_name: U3: Setup CI for s-c-d repo
activities.activity_description: Configure continuous integration for the spring-cloud-data repository using GitHub Actions. Create workflow files, set up build triggers on commits, and verify build passes.

activities.activity_name: U4: Resolve module-dependent JARs and add to Boot loader
activities.activity_description: Implement logic in the Boot loader to resolve external library dependencies (e.g., database drivers) required by OOTB modules. Use Maven dependency resolution or custom classloader to fetch and load JARs at runtime.
Refactor ModuleLauncher to be a Spring Boot application. Integrate Spring Boot's property handling, add autoconfiguration, and ensure backward compatibility. Include testing.

activities.activity_name: U6: Investigate porting PHD as provider for HDFS module
activities.activity_description: Research the best approach to port Pivotal Hadoop Distribution (PHD) as a provider to support HDFS module from Spring XD. Evaluate dependencies, classpath requirements, and prototype a minimal integration.

activities.activity_name: U7: Add REST support for stream commands
activities.activity_description: Design and implement REST endpoints in StreamController to handle stream commands (e.g., create, deploy, destroy, status). Use Spring Web MVC, define request/response models, and write integration tests.

activities.activity_name: U8: Setup CI for spring-cloud-stream-modules repo
activities.activity_description: Configure continuous integration for the spring-cloud-stream-modules repository using GitHub Actions. Create build workflows, handle multi-module builds, and verify on commits.
